Historical sampled occurrence on original2023/2024 collection dates only; not current persistence, establishment, reproduction, countywide prevalence, legal invasive status or complete county inventory.
Source fish TOTAL is positive and consistent with size-class counts; original counts and morph categories are retained without reconstructing abundance across rows, visits or morphs.

FISH_SAMPLING means sampling not conducted or suspended; this initial method admits blank values only. Nonblank flags and non-distinct rows are held from this method, not interpreted as absence or non-detection.

SAMPLED_FISH reports sufficient assessment effort, not whether positive captures occurred. Partial/interrupted reaches, statistical-frame exclusions and hand-picked sites can carry direct positive evidence with explicit qualifications.

Exact source UID joins to unique visit information and TAXA_ID joins to taxonomy; exact case-normalized source binomial and active publisher county FIPS/name/state. No fuzzy taxon mapping, retired-county conversion or neighboring-county inference.

Publisher NAD83 NHD sampling-frame coordinates are contextual, not exact fish capture geometry. Generalized boundary discrepancies and border rivers remain explicit, and unresolved larger source-location contradictions are held.

EPA identification and program QA support the published source, but individual specimens were not independently reidentified or universally voucher-verified. FINAL_NAME is a taxonomic field, not Final/Provisional result status.
The cited field manuals permit alternative specimen collection in some conditions; permission does not prove which gear or sequence produced a particular record.
Original publication and acquisition provenance are retained. Replay performs zero provider requests; its code commit identifies interpretation rather than a new source acquisition.
notes: Original fish, site and taxon rows, positive/excluded dispositions, source locators and the independently selected primary witness are retained in epa-nrsa-fish-witnesses.json.
